fields.label: Opening Balance
fields.description: Balance at the start of the statement period.

fields.label: Net Movement
fields.description: Net movement over the period (money in minus money out), not a balance.

fields.label: Closing Balance
fields.description: Balance at the end of the statement period.

fields.label: Transactions
fields.description: One row per transaction: date, description, money in, money out and balance.

fields.label: Relationship manager
fields.description: Name of the bank relationship manager.
